an5.308-1152:1.1: rāgassa bhikkhave pariññāya …pe… parikkhayāya pahānāya khayāya vayāya virāgāya nirodhāya cāgāya paṭinissaggāya pañca dhammā bhāvetabbā …pe…
an5.308-1152:1.2: dosassa … mohassa … kodhassa … upanāhassa makkhassa … paḷāsassa … issāya … macchariyassa … māyāya … sātheyyassa … thambhassa … sārambhassa … mānassa … atimānassa … madassa … pamādassa … abhiññāya …pe… pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya khayāya vayāya virāgāya nirodhāya cāgāya
an5.308-1152:3.5: pañcakanipāto niṭṭhito. suttantapiṭake aṅguttarakāyassa chakkanipāto namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa. paṭhamapaṇṇāsako āhuneyyavaggo paṭhamo 1 evamme
